en: What if we go to the movies on Saturday?
es: ¿Qué tal si vamos al cine el sábado?
why: After si the present stays plain.

en: I suggest we go to the movies on Saturday. (to a friend)
es: Te propongo que vayamos al cine el sábado.
why: Te propongo que always takes the subjunctive.

en: What if we order a pizza?
I propose that you pay half today. (formal)
es: Le propongo que pague la mitad hoy.
why: Le propongo que takes the subjunctive.
Cocinamos is plain present, which goes with qué tal si.

en: I propose that we start earlier. (to a friend)
es: Te propongo que empecemos más temprano.
why: Empecemos is subjunctive, which goes with te propongo que.

en: What if Rosa brings the dessert?
es: ¿Qué tal si Rosa trae el postre?
why: After qué tal si, the plain present.

en: I propose that we talk to Don Hernando first. (to a group)
es: Les propongo que hablemos con Don Hernando primero.
why: The subjunctive follows les propongo que.
